about_short_description.short_description: Raseedi is the first daily fintech App for underbanked masses.

product.name: Raseedi App
product.description: A mobile application that optimizes telecom usage by automatically selecting the cheapest SIM card for calls and tracks consumption across networks.

product.name: RaseediKash
product.description: An instant cash loan service integrated into the Raseedi app, offering short-term loans up to 3,000 EGP with minimal documentation and quick approval.

product.name: RaseediPay
product.description: A payment platform within the Raseedi app that enables users to recharge mobile credit, pay utility bills, and earn cashback points redeemable for payments.

product.name: Free Calls Feature
product.description: A feature in the Raseedi app that allows users to make free calls over WiFi or mobile data to other Raseedi members within their circle.

product.name: Loyalty Points System
product.description: A rewards system that grants users points for calls and payments, which can be used to pay for recharges and bills within the app.
